description: End-to-end composition proof of the full AlgoVoi keystone flow, through the post-decision execution-evidence tier. From raw identity, authority, and policy inputs, each content-addressed reference is recomputed first-principles (RFC 8785 JCS + SHA-256, no package import) and shown to equal the published output of its lite conformance set. The decision (guardrail_ref) is recomputed from the three composed references plus the verdict. The execution_ref is then recomputed over the EXACT decision_ref the chain produced, proving the executed action is consistent with the decision that authorized it (not merely correlated with an identity), and matches the published execution_ref_v1 reference. Finally trust_query_ref assesses the whole chain [passport_ref, mandate_ref, policy_bound_ref, decision_ref, execution_ref] in order, capping identity -> authority -> policy -> decision -> execution as one verdict. No new hashing primitive: every asserted value is an existing published expected output.

decision.construction: guardrail_ref = sha256: + SHA-256(JCS({agent_ref, mandate_ref, policy_bound_ref, verdict}))

execution.construction: execution_ref = sha256: + SHA-256(JCS({decision_ref, action_type, scope, outcome, executed_at_ms}))
execution.binds: decision_ref (the ALLOW decision the chain produced)

note: Recomputing any input field diverges the affected reference and every reference downstream of it. The execution tier is bound to the decision tier: the execution_ref preimage carries the decision_ref the chain produced, so an execution recorded under one decision cannot be re-attributed to another. trust_query_ref over the full ordered chain caps identity -> authority -> policy -> decision -> execution as one verdict.
